issues.where: PickerCarouselFeatureCycle.tsx icon span (ICONS[5] '↺'); visible in fa frames 90, 102-107 (final resting frame)
issues.problem: The icon span inherits Vazirmatn through FaRoot, and Vazirmatn (or its fallback) draws U+21BA as a small curled glyph that looks like an Arabic letter/hook, not the counter-clockwise refresh arrow the original shows (orig f107 shows a proper open circular arrow). The final resting frame therefore shows a wrong-looking icon. Other icons (◎ ✉ ◧ ◈ ★ ⚑) render acceptably.
issues.suggestedFix: Give the icon span its own symbol-safe font stack (e.g. fontFamily: "-apple-system,'Helvetica Neue','Segoe UI Symbol',sans-serif", the original's family) or replace the glyph with a small inline SVG; re-render f90/f107 and compare with orig.

issues.problem: The badge originally set its own Helvetica fontFamily; it now falls back to Vazirmatn Latin glyphs (heavier/rounder 'AI') and keeps letterSpacing 0.5. Header comment claims no tracking on Persian only; acceptable, but the badge look differs slightly from the source. Also the badge is mirrored to the right although the picker is symmetric, which is a defensible but unverified choice (document or keep).
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally restore a Latin sans fontFamily on the badge to match the source mark.

issues.where: Code hygiene (icon span ~line 118, closing FaRoot indentation)
issues.problem: Misaligned indentation of the icon span and of the FaRoot wrapper; Persian comments mixed with leftover Chinese comments (non-visible).

notes: Verified by re-rendering frames 0,3,8,14,20,31,45,60,75,90,107 and viewing fa vs orig (f3, f20, f45, f60, f90, f107). Translations are idiomatic (ZWNJ in پاک‌سازی، بخش‌بندی، اقدام‌های، گردش‌کارهای، آزمون نسخه‌ها; ی/ک correct, no letter-spacing, one line each, no overflow). Exports and the 108-frame duration are unchanged; vertical motion, pill breath, gradient and holds match the original beats (diff shows only text/font/icon-order/badge changes). Icon moves to the right (RTL start) of each label correctly; vertical list order and travel direction rightly unmirrored. No raster assets, no leftover Chinese/English except the intentional AI mark. Only real defect is the ↺ glyph substitution; otherwise near ship-ready.
